errors.slot_taken: That time has just been taken. Please choose another.
errors.block_taken: Someone already holds this block. Choose another room or time.
errors.outside_block: That time is outside the therapist's room block.
errors.block_has_appointments: This block has bookings. Move or cancel those appointments first, then release the block.
errors.hold_expired: This booking was not paid in time and has expired.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find that any more. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.forbidden: You're not allowed to do this.
errors.invalid: Something in the form isn't right. Check the fields and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

overview.title: Good to see you, {name}
overview.lead: This week at the centre: room use, your renters and the next things to do.
overview.occupancyText: Reserved blocks this week. Each shared room has {blocks} blocks a day.
overview.onboardingText: Where each renter is with their setup.

links.gridText: Who is in which room, day by day. Assign or release blocks.
links.roomsText: Add rooms, set private or shared, and change block times.
links.rentersText: Invite therapists and enter their business details.
links.rentText: Prices per room, invoicing day and this month's estimate.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.lead: The rooms at the centre. Shared rooms are rented in blocks; a private room belongs to one therapist.
rooms.emptyText: Add your first room to start renting it out.
rooms.kindSharedHint: Therapists reserve it in blocks (for example 08:00–12:00).
rooms.kindPrivateHint: One therapist uses it whenever they like, within their own working hours.
rooms.name: Name
rooms.activeHint: Rooms not in use can't be booked and are hidden from the grid.
rooms.templatesText: The fixed blocks that shared rooms are rented in.
rooms.templateHint: Changes apply to new reservations. Blocks already reserved keep their times.
rooms.timeError: The end must be after the start.

renters.title: Renters
renters.lead: The therapists who rent rooms at the centre.
renters.inviteText: They get an e-mail with a link to set up their account. (Demo: no e-mail is sent.)
renters.invitedText: In the real app, {email} gets the invitation by e-mail.
renters.name: Name
renters.emptyText: Invite the first therapist to get started.

renter.lead: Their practice at the centre and the business details for invoices.
renter.practiceText: How this therapist appears on the website and in booking.
renter.bookableHint: Clients can book this therapist on the website.
renter.paperHint: Works from a paper diary. You open small booking windows for them.
renter.businessText: Used on the invoices this therapist sends to clients. The therapist can see these details but not change them.
renter.korHint: No VAT on their invoices. Check this with their accountant.

rent.title: Rent
rent.lead: What renters pay for their rooms, and how the monthly invoices go out.
rent.pricesText: Each room has a fixed monthly price or a price per block. A new price starts on a date you choose; earlier months keep the old price.
rent.defaultRateText: Used for shared rooms without their own price.
rent.sheetText: The new price applies from the date below.

mode.fixed_monthlyText: The same amount every month, billed to the therapist in this room.
mode.per_blockText: An amount for every block reserved in this room.

rent.btwHint: Ask your accountant whether room rent is exempt or taxed.
rent.validFromHint: Usually the first day of a month.
rent.historyNote: The current price stops the day before. Invoices already sent never change.
rent.invoicingText: Rent invoices are made once a month from the reserved blocks and fixed rents.
rent.billingDayHint: The day of the month the invoices are made.
rent.reviewText: You get the invoices to check, then send them yourself.
rent.autoText: Invoices go out on the invoice day without a check.
rent.estimateText: Worked out from the blocks reserved now and today's prices. The real invoice can differ when blocks change.
rent.lineBlocks: Room {number}: {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}
rent.unpriced: {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}} without a price
rent.estimateFootnote: Invoices are made on day {day} of the month. Nothing is sent from this preview.

grid.title: Room grid
grid.lead: All rooms for one week. Tap a free block to assign it, or a reserved block to see or release it.
grid.appointments: {count, plural, =0 {no appointments} one {# appointment} other {# appointments}}
grid.privacy: Only times and treatments are shown here, never client or health details.
grid.releaseOneNote: Only this date is released. The other weeks stay reserved.
grid.hasBookingsTitle: {count, plural, one {This block has # booking} other {This block has # bookings}}
grid.hasBookingsText: A block with bookings can't be released. Ask the therapist to move or cancel those appointments first, then release the block.
grid.privateText: A private room: the therapist books it within their own working hours.
grid.weeklyHint: Reserve this block every {weekday} from this date.
grid.takenText: This block was just taken. Refresh the grid to see who has it.

therapies.title: Therapies
therapies.lead: The therapies the centre offers. Therapists link their services to these, and clients can browse by therapy.
therapies.emptyText: Add the therapies offered at the centre.
therapies.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {no therapists} one {# therapist} other {# therapists}}
therapies.activeHint: Hidden therapies stay linked to existing services but can't be chosen for new ones.

paper.title: Paper calendar
paper.lead: Some therapists keep their own diary. Open the times in which clients can book them online; everything else stays closed.
paper.closeBooked: This window has bookings, so it can't be closed. Ask the therapist to move or cancel them first.
paper.closeHint: A window with bookings can't be closed. A window fills up by itself when it is fully booked.
paper.emptyText: Open a window so clients can book online.
paper.noTherapistsTitle: No therapist uses a paper calendar
paper.noTherapistsText: Turn on “paper calendar” for a renter first.
paper.openText: Clients can book this therapist online only inside open windows.
paper.placeHint: In a shared room, a window must lie inside a block the therapist has reserved.
paper.noPlacesText: This therapist has no room blocks in the next 8 weeks and no private room. Assign a block in the room grid first.
paper.timeError: The end must be after the start.
paper.openedText: Clients can now book this time online.
